message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on the fact: obtaining fake VAT special invoices, forging invoices, using them for tax evasion? The facts: defendant obtained 26 sets of VAT special invoices from a company, but the company never had business with the other company, the invoice stamps match but taxpayer ID different, belongs to forged VAT invoices. This is likely "伪造增值税专用发票罪" (Crime of forging VAT special invoices) under Chinese criminal law. Also possibly "非法获取国家税收优惠发票罪" or "骗取增值税发票罪". Under Chinese law, there is a crime "伪造、变造发票罪" (Article 176 of Criminal Law). Also "偷税漏税罪" maybe but the fact only shows forging invoices, not tax evasion. So the direct support is forging VAT invoices. Also "非法获取发票罪"? The law: Article 176: "伪造、变造发票、收据、凭证，或者买卖、提供伪造、变造的发票、收据、凭证的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处或者单处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So the crime is "伪造发票罪". In Chinese criminal law, the specific name is "伪造增值税专用发票罪". So answer: [伪造增值税专用发票罪] <eoa>. Use semicolon if multiple, but only one.

Thus final.
